# Luna Pediatric Dentistry

> Luna Pediatric Dentistry provides comprehensive pediatric dental care across multiple Texas locations, specializing in preventive, restorative, and emergency services for children with compassionate, family-focused treatment.

Luna Pediatric Dentistry is a multi-location pediatric dental practice serving the greater Houston area, including Richmond, Sugar Land, Katy, and surrounding communities. The practice is led by Dr. Dzhuliya Servetnik and offers a full range of children's dental services from early preventive care through emergency treatment, with flexible payment options and sedation dentistry available.
